retrospectives.cohort_definition: accepted v1.0 Treasury release: one unavailable-metric snapshot for each of nine published destinations
known_limitations: Metrics are manual operator entries only when present; no official platform analytics were collected.
The cohort may be confounded by topic, timing, and audience growth.
No causal or public performance conclusion is permitted.
retrospectives.recommended_learning_action: Do not infer performance. If an operator later records comparable manual metrics, append them as new observations.
